title: Ameriprise Financial Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend
summary: The Board of Directors of Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.70 per common share payable on August 21, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on August 3, 2026. At Ameriprise Financial, we have been helping people feel confident about their financial future for more than 130 years. With extensive investment advice, global asset management capabilities and insurance solutions, and a nationwide network of more than 10,000 financial advisors, we have the strength and expertise to serve the full range of individual and institutional investors' financial needs. © 2026 Ameriprise Financial, Inc.
